*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM READ_TABLES                                              *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       ........                                                      *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
form read_tables.
  refresh t006_tab.
  refresh t006a_tab.
  refresh flag_tab.
* Masseinheiten nach interner Einheit sortieren
  select * from t006 into table t006_tab.
  sort t006_tab by msehi.
* ADD-On (IS-Oil - KH) / Output sorted by MSEHI   "*023i
  if g_oilact eq c_actyes.                        "*023i
    perform read_and_check(SAPLOIB_MUNIT) tables  "*023i
            t006_tab                              "*023i Input
            t006_oib_tab                          "*023i Output=sorted
            if found.                             "*023i exi.in IS-OIL
  endif.                                          "*023i
* sprachabh. Einheiten der Sprache LANGUAGE nach int. Einheit sortieren
  select * from t006a into table t006a_tab where spras eq language.
  sort t006a_tab by msehi.
* alle Einheiten der passenden Dimension besorgen
* Mußfelder vorbelegen, d.h. sprachabh. Schluessel ggf. ergaenzen
* loop at t006_tab where dimid eq old_dimid.
  loop at t006_tab.
    t006a_tab-mandt = sy-mandt.
    t006a_tab-spras = language.
    t006a_tab-msehi = t006_tab-msehi.
    read table t006a_tab with key t006a_tab(7) binary search.
    flag_tab-flag = space.
    flag_tab-flag_a = space.
    flag_tab-mark = space.
    case sy-subrc.
      when 0.
*       wenn Einheit in T006A_TAB gefunden, pruefen, ob ein Schluessel
*       fehlt; Schluessel ggf. ergaenzen    --> modify
        if action eq 'CHAN'.
          index = sy-tabix.
          t006a = t006a_tab.
          if t006a_tab-mseh3 eq space
          or t006a_tab-mseh6 eq space.
            refresh t006a_all.
            loop at t006a_tab.
              t006a_all = t006a_tab.
              append t006a_all.
            endloop.
          endif.
          if t006a_tab-mseh3 eq space.
            do.
              IF num_3 = 999.
*               To avoid a deadlock - note 1549635
                exit.
              ENDIF.
              num_3 = num_3 + 1.       "fehlende Schluessel erzeugen
              cha_3 = num_3.
              sw_found = space.
              loop at t006a_all where mseh3 eq cha_3.
                sw_found = 'X'.
              endloop.
              if sw_found eq space.
                t006a-mseh3 = cha_3.
                exit.
              endif.
            enddo.
            flag_tab-flag = flg_update.
            if t006a-msehi ne old_mssie.
              flag_tab-mark = flg_mark.
            endif.
            modify t006a_tab index sy-tabix.
          endif.
          if t006a_tab-mseh6 eq space.
            do.
              num_6 = num_6 + 1.       "fehlende Schluessel erzeugen
              cha_6 = num_6.
              sw_found = space.
              loop at t006a_all where mseh6 eq cha_6.
                sw_found = 'X'.
              endloop.
              if sw_found eq space.
                t006a-mseh6 = cha_6.
                exit.
              endif.
            enddo.
            flag_tab-flag = flg_update.
            if t006a-msehi ne old_mssie.
              flag_tab-mark = flg_mark.
            endif.
            t006a_tab = t006a.
            modify t006a_tab index index.
          endif.
        endif.
      when others.
*       Einheit nicht gefunden: beide sprachabhaengigen Einheiten
*       muessen ergaenzt werden --> insert
        clear t006a.
        t006a-mandt = sy-mandt.
        t006a-spras = language.
        t006a-msehi = t006_tab-msehi.
        if action eq 'CHAN'.
          index = sy-tabix.
          refresh t006a_all.
          loop at t006a_tab.
            t006a_all = t006a_tab.
            append t006a_all.
          endloop.
          do.
            num_6 = num_6 + 1.
            cha_6 = num_6.
            sw_found = space.
            loop at t006a_all where mseh6 eq cha_6.
              sw_found = 'X'.
            endloop.
            if sw_found eq space.
              t006a-mseh6 = cha_6.
              exit.
            endif.
          enddo.
          do.
            IF num_3 = 999.
*             To avoid a deadlock - note 1549635
              exit.
            ENDIF.
            num_3 = num_3 + 1.
            cha_3 = num_3.
            sw_found = space.
            loop at t006a_all where mseh3 eq cha_3.
              sw_found = 'X'.
            endloop.
            if sw_found eq space.
              t006a-mseh3 = cha_3.
              exit.
            endif.
          enddo.
*         flag_tab-flag_a = flg_insert.
          t006a_tab = t006a.
          if t006a-msehi ne old_mssie.
            flag_tab-mark = flg_mark.
          endif.
*        endif.                                             "B20K058430
          insert t006a_tab index index.
          t006a = t006a_tab.
          insert t006a.
        endif.                                              "B20K058430
    endcase.
    flag_tab-msehi = t006_tab-msehi.
    if t006_tab-dimid eq old_dimid.
      append flag_tab.
    endif.
  endloop.

* Tabellen trennen
  refresh t006_all.
  refresh t006_oib_all.     "only important for ADD-On IS-Oil/KH "*023i
  refresh t006a_all.
  t006_tab-mandt = sy-mandt.
  loop at t006a_tab.
    t006a_all = t006a_tab.
    append t006a_all.
    t006_tab-msehi = t006a_tab-msehi.
    read table t006_tab with key t006_tab(6) binary search.
    if sy-subrc eq 0.
      t006_all = t006_tab.
      if g_oilact eq c_actyes.             "IS-Oil active        "*023i
        read table t006_oib_tab index sy-tabix.                  "*023i
        t006_oib_all = t006_oib_tab.                             "*023i
      endif.                                                     "*023i
      if t006_tab-dimid ne t006d-dimid."nur aktuelle Dimension
        delete t006_tab index sy-tabix.
        if g_oilact eq c_actyes.             "IS-Oil active      "*023i
          delete t006_oib_tab index sy-tabix.                    "*023i
        endif.                                                   "*023i
        delete t006a_tab.
      endif.
      append t006_all.
      if g_oilact eq c_actyes.             "IS-Oil active        "*023i
        append t006_oib_all.                                     "*023i
      endif.                                                     "*023i
    else.
      delete t006a_tab.
    endif.
  endloop.

* Meldung: Tabelle wurde maschinell aufgefüllt
  loop at flag_tab where mark ne space.
    message s011.
    exit.
  endloop.
* Eintraege laut Korrektur markieren
* fuer Transport Daten immer neu nachlesen
  if action eq 'TRAN'.
*   loop at e071k_tab where objname eq 'T006'.
    loop at e071k_tab where mastertype eq 'TDAT'    "8.7.96
                        and mastername eq 'CUNI'    "8.7.96
                        and objname    eq 'T006'.   "8.7.96
      read table flag_tab with key e071k_tab-tabkey+3(3) binary search.
      if sy-subrc eq 0.
        flag_tab-mark = 'X'.
        modify flag_tab index sy-tabix.
      endif.
    endloop.
  endif.
endform.

             exporting

             importing

            call function 'DEQUEUE_ALL'.

            clear modus.
            call function 'DEQUEUE_ALL'.
